eventDescription: A gathering for women to grow in community, worship together, and connect deeply with God.
seoTitle: Thrive 2027 | A Gathering for Women | Omaha, NE
seoDescription: Thrive is a two-day gathering for women sixteen and older at Christ Community Church in Omaha, Nebraska, on February 5 & 6, 2027, featuring Bible teacher Lisa Harper. Friday evening and Saturday morning will feature worship and teaching around the theme *Awe and Delight*.
shareDescription: February 5 & 6, 2027, in Omaha, Nebraska | Featuring Lisa Harper | For women sixteen and older
